we have proposed an approach for context awareness based on semantic technologies that can be easily adapted in any pervasive environment.
the proposed semantic reasoning framework is able to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environments.

we have developed a framework to monitor and manage pervasive computing environments, which is based on a semantic reasoning framework, and we have implemented a scenario to monitor elderly people in smart homes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new semantic framework for the management of pervasive environments, based on the μConcept Knowledge Representation Language and the μConcept Rule Language.
the development of a new Semantic Reasoning Framework (SRF), which is able to handle the context information in a semantic and dynamic way.
the development of new techniques to supervise and manage contexts and objects in pervasive computing environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the proposed approach, based on a semantic reasoning framework, allows the system to understand and to manage easily the behavior and contexts handled by all actors, to take an adequate action, and to dynamically visualize the information.
the use of a μConcept based semantic reasoning framework allows to supervise and manage pervasive computing environments, and in particular to monitor and manage elderly people in smart homes.
the proposed semantic reasoning framework is able to supervise and manage pervasive environments and to provide an intelligent monitoring of elderly people.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of a μConcept-based framework for the supervision of the environment allows us to: (1) easily manage the information coming from heterogeneous sensors, actuators and devices (2) dynamically visualize the environment (3) easily manage the context events and their evolution (4) take the appropriate decisions and actions.

the proposed approach is based on the use and combination of the semantic technology, the context awareness technology and the semantic reasoning technology to supervise and monitor pervasive environments.
we have proposed a novel semantic reasoning framework that allows us to supervise and manage contexts and objects in a pervasive computing environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed framework is able to manage the context of the elderly people in the home and to provide a semantic reasoning layer for the management of the environment and the interaction with the elderly people, in order to provide them with a personalized and adapted service.
the μConcept language allows us to model and reason on the context in a very efficient way, which is a crucial point for pervasive applications, where the context has to be monitored in real time.
the proposed semantic reasoning framework can help to manage and supervise the environment and to take an adequate action according to the context and the situation.
